title: Home views
blurb: Every family at the frame it draws when nobody names a viewport.
note: A placeholder gallery. These are diagnostic renders at 640×360, kept here so the page has something real on it while the first curated run finishes; the wallpapers that replace them will be full-frame work with release downloads behind them.

title: Mandelbrot
caption: z² + c, centred at −0.77 with a width of 4.4 — wide enough for the needle on the left, tall enough for the bulbs above and below.
alt: The Mandelbrot set, black against a violet field, its needle reaching left.

title: Multibrot, degree 3
caption: z³ + c. Two-fold symmetry about the origin, and the tallest set of the six against a landscape frame: it needs a width of 5.2 to be given its own height.
alt: A two-lobed multibrot set, symmetric top to bottom about the origin.

title: Multibrot, degree 4
caption: z⁴ + c. Three main lobes and a centre shifted to −0.23, the only set here that leans off the origin without being a Mandelbrot.
alt: A three-lobed multibrot set leaning left of centre.

title: Multibrot, degree 5
caption: z⁵ + c. Four-fold symmetry and the most compact of the five measured families: a width of 3.6 holds all of it.
alt: A four-lobed multibrot set, nearly square, filling most of the frame.

title: Julia
caption: z² + c for a fixed c of (−0.0781, −0.6515). A Julia set's extent depends on the constant that makes it, so there is no one frame to measure — this is the whole-plane view, the exception among the six.
alt: A filled Julia set of connected spirals running corner to corner.

title: Phoenix
caption: The classic Phoenix recurrence, which carries the previous iterate as well as the current one. Centred at (0.04, 0) with a width of 5.0: a portrait subject in a landscape frame, and the margin either side is what that costs.
alt: Two flame-shaped Phoenix lobes stacked vertically in a wide frame.
